requalified_public_negative.interpretation: Direct numeric raw-character context weights did not transfer the learned answer-span mechanism to any of 24 human-written SQuAD public questions despite fitting 75/128 training questions. Conventional unpretrained logistic also generalized poorly at 1/24 while char-retrieval gave 3/24. This falsifies the preset public requirement of >=2/24. No AGI or general language gain; numerical weight editing is not shown to be superior. 20/24 answers are representable by raw candidate enumerator, so missing candidate coverage does not alone explain 0/24.
